name: Divya Prasanth Paraman
affiliation: Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering

news.text: Poster *Tracing Communicative Motive in LLM-Generated Visualizations* accepted at IEEE VIS 2026.
Gave a guest lecture on AI-assisted visualization systems and human–AI collaboration in Information Visualization at IU.
Started my PhD in Intelligent Systems Engineering with [Prof. Katy Börner](https://cns-iu.github.io/katy/).
Graduated with an M.S. in Data Science from Indiana University Bloomington.
